sources.snippet: Welcome to this tutorial project on MNIST Classification using a Fully Connected Neural Network (MLP) implemented in PyTorch. In this project, we'll walk through the process of building, training, and evaluating a simple neural network to recognize handwritten digits from the MNIST dataset.
